enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Place arm under pillow. Turn to back. Stretch legs. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up to chin. Sleep.

Stand up from bed. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Take out cereal from cupboard. Take out bowl. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Pick up spoon. Eat cereal. Place bowl in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up bag. Walk out.

Walk to car. Unlock car. Open car door. Sit in driver's seat. Close car door. Fasten seatbelt. Start engine. Adjust mirrors. Release parking brake. Drive. Stop at red light. Drive. Park car. Turn off engine. Unfasten seatbelt. Open car door. Step out. Close car door. Lock car. Walk to workplace.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Enter workplace. Greet colleagues: 'Good morning.' Put on lab coat. Check patient list. Pick up clipboard. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient: 'Hello, how are you feeling?' Check patient vital signs. Use stethoscope. Record notes. Walk to nurses' station. Use computer. Update patient records. Talk to doctor: 'Patient needs medication adjustment.' Administer medication. Walk to next patient.
Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Select food. Pay for food. Sit at table. Eat food. Drink water. Talk to colleague: 'Busy morning?' Throw away trash. Return tray. Walk back to work area.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to patient room. Check patient monitor. Adjust IV drip. Talk to patient: 'Press the call button if you need anything.' Walk to supply closet. Take out gloves. Put on gloves. Walk to examination room. Prepare instruments. Assist doctor with procedure. Remove gloves. Wash hands. Walk to break room. Drink water. Walk to nurses' station. Answer phone: 'Nurses' station, how can I help?' Write notes. Walk to patient room. Discharge patient. Walk to reception. Talk to receptionist. Walk to office. Sit at desk. Type report.

Walk to car. Unlock car. Open car door. Sit in driver's seat. Close car door. Fasten seatbelt. Start engine. Adjust mirrors. Release parking brake. Drive. Stop at red light. Drive. Park car at home. Turn off engine. Unfasten seatbelt. Open car door. Step out. Close car door. Lock car. Walk to house.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out pot. Take out cutting board. Take out knife. Wash vegetables. Cut vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pot on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Add spices. Cover pot. Wait. Turn off stove. Take out plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Pick up plate. Place plate in sink.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Adjust volume. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Pick up drink. Drink. Put down drink. Adjust sitting position. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Charging devices and checking storm updates
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up phone. Plug phone into charger. Pick up computer. Plug computer into charger. Turn on computer. Open weather app. Check storm updates. Read forecast. Check news website. Close browser. Turn off computer. Unplug computer charger. Pick up tablet. Plug tablet into charger. Check storm updates on tablet. Turn off tablet. Sit on sofa.

Sit on sofa. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Continue reading. Put down book. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Personal hygiene and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Place arm under pillow. Turn to back. Stretch legs. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up to chin. Sleep.
